findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smart_filter_catalog, check_tool, listing_security, list_watched_tools, watch_alerts, a2a_agent_search, a2a_agent, list_listings, list_mcp_servers, list_comments, create_listing · Private data: check_tool, listing_security, listing_tools, list_watched_tools, a2a_agent_search, list_comments, create_listing, pricing · Public sink: smart_filter_catalog, check_tool, watch_alerts, a2a_agent_search, create_listing · Destructive: listing_security, like_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smart_filter_catalog, check_tool, listing_security, list_watched_tools, watch_alerts, a2a_agent_search, a2a_agent, list_listings, list_mcp_servers, list_comments, create_listing · Private data: check_tool, listing_security, listing_tools, list_watched_tools, a2a_agent_search, list_comments, create_listing, pricing · Public sink: smart_filter_catalog, check_tool, watch_alerts, a2a_agent_search, create_listing · Destructive: listing_security, like_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "smart_filter_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
